top_signals.title: Currie Sees Permanent 'Regime Shift' in Oil Market
top_signals.summary: Jeff Currie, CEO and founder of Real Macro, says physical oil is pricing in a permanent "regime shift" in energy markets. Speaking to Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar at the Adipec conference in Abu Dhabi, Currie explains why Brent is close to $99 a barrel for long-dated contracts, and why the true driver isn't near-term conflict, but an aggressive push toward system-wide energy security and redundancy. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gold Climbs Back From One-Year Low as Dip Buyers Arrest Slide
top_signals.summary: Gold rose, as lower oil prices offered some respite from inflationary pressures and dip buyers were drawn by the metal’s slide on Friday to the lowest in a year.
